name: Tea Museum, Munnar (KDHP)
summary: The Tea Museum at Munnar, run by Kanan Devan Hills Plantations, tells the story of tea in the High Range since the first planting in 1876. Visitors see old machinery, a working miniature tea factory and a tasting.
highlights: Covers tea growing in Munnar since 1876
A 1905 tea roller and a wheel from the Kundaly Valley Light Railway
Miniature tea factory showing each processing step
Tea tasting as part of the visit
Run by Kanan Devan Hills Plantations
